shots.scene: 欣欣站在试剂柜前，手里举着一本空白封面的小册子，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a chemical cabinet, holding up a booklet with a blank cover and waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 每瓶化学品，都有一本说明书。

shots.scene: 小册子翻开，内页分成整齐的十六格，格内空白
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the booklet opens to pages divided into sixteen neat blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 今天我们学会读懂它。

shots.scene: 阿杰在微生物实验室配培养基，伸手去拿一瓶白色颗粒试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student prepares culture medium at a lab bench and reaches for a bottle of white pellets with a blank label and a corrosion pictogram.
shots.narration: 阿杰配培养基，要调酸碱度。

shots.scene: 阿杰没戴手套，打算直接用手去抓颗粒，旁边出现红色问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, without gloves, is about to pick up pellets with bare fingers; a red question mark appears beside him.
shots.narration: 他拿起一瓶碱，准备直接上手。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指了指瓶身上的腐蚀象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at the corrosion pictogram on the bottle.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先看看它的说明书。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：化学品还有说明书？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 有的，它就叫 SDS。

shots.scene: 一本空白封面的文件夹，旁边是一排试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A thick binder with a blank cover next to a row of reagent bottles with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: SDS 是化学品的详细资料文件。

shots.scene: 单个试剂瓶和由几个瓶子混合成的大瓶，各连一份文件
shots.prompt_en: A single pure reagent bottle and a mixed solution bottle, each linked by a line to its own blank document. No people.
shots.narration: 纯物质和混合物，都有自己的一份。

shots.scene: 旧文件封面上的标题被划掉，换成新标题
shots.prompt_en: An old document with a crossed-out blank title bar beside a new document with a fresh blank title bar. No people.
shots.narration: 它以前叫 MSDS，现在统称 SDS。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开文件，指着其中一页
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens the binder and points to one page.
shots.narration: 它提供化学品的基本信息。

shots.section_title: 法律要求提供，告知危害
shots.scene: 法槌图标和一份空白文件，文件上有印章
shots.prompt_en: A gavel icon beside a blank document with a red seal. No people.
shots.narration: 提供 SDS，是法律的要求。
overlay: 法律要求提供，告知危害

shots.section_title: 法律要求提供，告知危害
shots.scene: 文件上浮出火焰、腐蚀、骷髅等象形图
shots.prompt_en: Hazard pictograms for flame, corrosion and skull rise from a blank document. No people.
shots.narration: 它首先告诉你：这东西有什么危害。

shots.section_title: 告诉你怎么用、怎么存、怎么处置
shots.scene: 三个图标依次亮起：手拿瓶子、柜子、废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up one after another: a hand holding a bottle, a storage cabinet, a waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 还告诉你怎么用、怎么存、怎么处置。
overlay: 告诉你怎么用、怎么存、怎么处置

shots.section_title: 告诉你怎么用、怎么存、怎么处置
shots.scene: 小研一手拿瓶，一手翻着文件对照
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a bottle in one hand and checks a blank document in the other.
shots.narration: 用之前对照着看，心里就有底。

shots.section_title: 法规依据：美国规定与 GHS
shots.scene: 一本空白封面的法规书和印章
shots.prompt_en: A thick rulebook with a blank cover and an official stamp. No people.
shots.narration: SDS 是化学品安全的重要部分，受法规约束。
overlay: 法规依据：美国规定与 GHS

shots.section_title: 法规依据：美国规定与 GHS
shots.scene: 地图上一个国家轮廓被点亮，旁边一本法规书
shots.prompt_en: A world map with one country outline highlighted next to a blank rulebook. No people.
shots.narration: 比如美国职业安全卫生法规就有要求，

shots.section_title: 法规依据：美国规定与 GHS
shots.scene: 地球图标周围一圈相同的象形图
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by a ring of identical hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 全球统一的分类和标签制度也有规定。

shots.section_title: 目的：让使用者和救援者知情
shots.scene: 实验员和穿防护服的救援人员各拿着一份文件
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the security officer each hold a copy of the same blank document.
shots.narration: SDS 的目的，是让人掌握必要信息。
overlay: 目的：让使用者和救援者知情

shots.section_title: 目的：让使用者和救援者知情
shots.scene: 实验员图标与救援人员图标被一条线连到同一份文件
shots.prompt_en: A lab worker icon and an emergency responder icon both connected by lines to one document icon. No people.
shots.narration: 使用的人要看，赶来救援的人也要看。

shots.section_title: 用途一：安全操作、储存、处置
shots.scene: 小研戴手套轻拿试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and goggles, handles a reagent bottle carefully.
shots.narration: 第一，教你安全地操作。
overlay: 用途一：安全操作、储存、处置

shots.section_title: 用途一：安全操作、储存、处置
shots.scene: 试剂瓶放进分格的试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle is placed into a compartment of a chemical storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，教你正确地储存。

shots.section_title: 用途一：安全操作、储存、处置
shots.scene: 空瓶和废液放进有标识的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: A labeled waste container receives a used bottle; blank tag on the container. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，教你规范地处置。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓图上，皮肤、眼睛、肺部依次亮红
shots.prompt_en: A human outline where the skin, eyes and lungs light up red one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 它还告诉你：伤身体的风险。

shots.scene: 吸入、接触皮肤、入口三个途径的图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons for routes of exposure: inhalation, skin contact, ingestion. No people.
shots.narration: 从哪里进入人体，伤到哪里。

shots.scene: 一个试剂瓶旁出现火焰象形图
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a flame hazard pictogram beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 会不会着火，着火有多猛。

shots.scene: 两个瓶子靠近时中间冒出闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: Two bottles move closer together and a lightning bolt symbol appears between them. No people.
shots.narration: 和什么东西放一起会起反应。

shots.scene: 两个瓶子被分开，中间画一道隔线
shots.prompt_en: The two bottles are separated by a dividing line. No people.
shots.narration: 知道了，才能把它们分开。

shots.scene: 水滴、鱼和树的图标，旁边一个试剂瓶被拦住
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a water droplet, a fish and a tree, with a reagent bottle blocked by a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 对水体和生物有没有害。

shots.scene: 一本说明书展开成十六格，格子按顺序编号
shots.prompt_en: A document unfolds into sixteen numbered boxes arranged in order. No people.
shots.narration: SDS 分成固定的十六个部分。

shots.scene: 前七格高亮，后九格变灰
shots.prompt_en: The first seven boxes are highlighted while the last nine turn grey. No people.
shots.narration: 这一集讲前七部分，后面下集讲。

shots.scene: 说明书第一格放大，里面是瓶子图标
shots.prompt_en: The first box of the document enlarges, showing a bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一部分：化学品及企业标识。

shots.scene: 瓶身标签和文件第一页上的名称位置同时闪亮
shots.prompt_en: The name area on a bottle label and on the first page of a document glow at the same time. No people.
shots.narration: 先写清楚物质或混合物的名称。

shots.scene: 一串数字格子组成的号码牌，旁边一个瓶子
shots.prompt_en: A tag made of number boxes next to a reagent bottle; digits are not readable. No people.
shots.narration: 还有唯一的识别号，比如 CAS 号。

shots.scene: 两个外观一样的瓶子，号码牌不同
shots.prompt_en: Two identical-looking bottles with different number tags. No people.
shots.narration: 名字可能相似，号码不会重复。

shots.scene: 文件上出现一个对勾和实验台图标
shots.prompt_en: A document shows a check mark and a lab bench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 推荐用途：它本来是做什么用的。

shots.scene: 工厂图标、电话图标和信封图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a factory, a telephone and an envelope linked to a document. No people.
shots.narration: 供应商信息：厂家和联系方式。

shots.scene: 小研拿起电话，看着文件
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a phone while reading a blank document.
shots.narration: 有疑问或出事，可以找到厂家。

shots.scene: 一瓶白色颗粒，瓶上标签只有腐蚀象形图
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of white pellets with a label showing only a corrosion pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 举个例子：氢氧化钠。

shots.scene: 号码牌和瓶子合在一起，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The number tag clips onto the bottle and a green check mark appears. No people.
shots.narration: 名称加 CAS 号，就锁定了它。

shots.scene: 说明书第二格放大，里面是象形图
shots.prompt_en: The second box of the document enlarges, showing hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 第二部分：危险性概述。

shots.scene: 瓶子被分进腐蚀、易燃等不同类别的格子
shots.prompt_en: Bottles sort into category boxes marked with corrosion and flame pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 先按统一规则分类，比如腐蚀、易燃。

shots.section_title: 标签要素：信号词和说明
shots.scene: 标签上方一行醒目的空白横条，颜色为红色
shots.prompt_en: A label with a bold red blank banner at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 标签要素里有信号词。
overlay: 标签要素：信号词和说明

shots.section_title: 标签要素：信号词和说明
shots.scene: 两个横条：红色较重、橙色较轻
shots.prompt_en: Two banners side by side: a heavier red one and a lighter orange one. No people.
shots.narration: 危险比警告更严重。

shots.section_title: 标签要素：信号词和说明
shots.scene: 标签上几行横线表示文字说明
shots.prompt_en: A label with several blank lines under the banner. No people.
shots.narration: 危险说明：会造成什么伤害。

shots.section_title: 标签要素：信号词和说明
shots.scene: 横线旁出现手套、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Glove and goggles icons appear beside the blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 防范说明：该怎样预防。

shots.scene: 一排红框菱形象形图：火焰、腐蚀、骷髅、感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A row of red diamond hazard pictograms: flame, corrosion, skull, exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 象形图，一眼看出危害类型。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着腐蚀象形图，若有所悟
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at the corrosion pictogram and nods.
shots.narration: 这个图，就是会腐蚀皮肤和金属。

shots.section_title: 示例：氢氧化钠有强腐蚀性
shots.scene: 氢氧化钠瓶子旁出现腐蚀象形图和红色横条
shots.prompt_en: The pellet bottle with a corrosion pictogram and a red banner. No people.
shots.narration: 氢氧化钠，信号词是危险。
overlay: 示例：氢氧化钠有强腐蚀性

shots.section_title: 示例：氢氧化钠有强腐蚀性
shots.scene: 手和眼睛图标上出现灼伤红斑
shots.prompt_en: Hand and eye icons with red burn marks. No people.
shots.narration: 会造成严重皮肤灼伤和眼损伤。

shots.section_title: 示例：氢氧化钠有强腐蚀性
shots.scene: 情景中阿杰缩回手，戴上手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls his hand back and puts on gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 所以阿杰不能徒手去抓。

shots.section_title: 第三部分：纯物质的成分
shots.scene: 说明书第三格放大，里面是一个瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The third box of the document enlarges, showing a single bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第三部分：成分和组成信息。
overlay: 第三部分：纯物质的成分

shots.section_title: 第三部分：纯物质的成分
shots.scene: 一个纯净的瓶子，旁边写着单一成分
shots.prompt_en: A single pure substance bottle linked to one blank line. No people.
shots.narration: 纯物质，写明它的化学组成。

shots.section_title: 混合物：列出各成分和浓度
shots.scene: 混合液瓶子分解出三种颜色的小瓶，各带一个百分比条
shots.prompt_en: A mixed solution bottle splits into three small colored bottles, each with a bar showing proportion. No people.
shots.narration: 混合物，要列出每种成分和浓度。
overlay: 混合物：列出各成分和浓度

shots.section_title: 混合物：列出各成分和浓度
shots.scene: 其中一个小瓶亮起危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: One of the small bottles lights up with a hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 哪种成分有危害，一看便知。

shots.scene: 氢氧化钠瓶旁一个满格的进度条
shots.prompt_en: The pellet bottle beside a fully filled bar. No people.
shots.narration: 固体氢氧化钠，浓度百分之百。

shots.scene: 说明书第四格放大，里面是急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The fourth box of the document enlarges, showing a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 第四部分：急救措施。

shots.scene: 眼睛、皮肤、吸入、食入四个图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a column: eye, skin, inhalation, ingestion. No people.
shots.narration: 按接触途径，写清怎么急救。

shots.scene: 皮肤图标上出现发红、刺痛的小闪线
shots.prompt_en: A skin icon with redness and small pain lines. No people.
shots.narration: 症状和效应：比如刺激、灼伤。

shots.scene: 小研对照文件观察自己的手背
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the back of her gloved hand while reading a blank document.
shots.narration: 知道症状，才能早发现。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁一个红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 什么情况必须立即就医，也写明了。

shots.scene: 医院图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon lights up next to the document. No people.
shots.narration: 看到就知道，该不该马上去医院。

shots.scene: 嘴巴图标和催吐动作图标，后者被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A mouth icon next to a vomiting icon that is crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 氢氧化钠误食，不要催吐。

shots.scene: 水杯漱口图标，接着是医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A cup-and-rinse icon followed by a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 漱口，并立即送医。

shots.scene: 说明书第五格放大，里面是火焰和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The fifth box of the document enlarges, showing a flame and an extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 第五部分：消防措施。

shots.scene: 水、泡沫、干粉、二氧化碳四种灭火剂图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of four extinguishing media: water, foam, dry powder, carbon dioxide. No people.
shots.narration: 先写适用的灭火剂，比如水、泡沫。

shots.scene: 瓶子受热膨胀，周围冒出烟雾图标
shots.prompt_en: A bottle heated by flames bulges with smoke icons around it. No people.
shots.narration: 特别危险性：燃烧会产生什么。

shots.scene: 烟雾中出现骷髅小图标
shots.prompt_en: A small skull icon appears inside the smoke cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 比如有毒烟气，或者容器爆裂。

shots.scene: 消防人员装备图标：防护服、呼吸器、头盔
shots.prompt_en: Icons of firefighter gear: protective suit, breathing apparatus, helmet. No people.
shots.narration: 还写明消防人员需要的防护。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员把文件交给赶来的救援人员
shots.prompt_en: The security officer hands a blank document to an arriving responder at the lab door.
shots.narration: 救援的人也能从这里查到。

shots.section_title: 示例：不燃，但遇金属放氢气
shots.scene: 氢氧化钠瓶旁的火焰图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The pellet bottle beside a flame icon that is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 氢氧化钠本身不会燃烧。
overlay: 示例：不燃，但遇金属放氢气

shots.section_title: 示例：不燃，但遇金属放氢气
shots.scene: 瓶子靠近金属块时冒出气泡
shots.prompt_en: The bottle near a metal block, with bubbles rising between them. No people.
shots.narration: 但它遇到某些金属，会放出氢气。

shots.section_title: 示例：不燃，但遇金属放氢气
shots.scene: 水雾喷向一排容器，起冷却作用
shots.prompt_en: A fine water spray mist cools a row of closed containers. No people.
shots.narration: 火场里可用水雾冷却容器。

shots.section_title: 第六部分：人员与环境防护
shots.scene: 说明书第六格放大，里面是倒下的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The sixth box of the document enlarges, showing a tipped-over bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第六部分：泄漏应急处理。
overlay: 第六部分：人员与环境防护

shots.section_title: 第六部分：人员与环境防护
shots.scene: 小研戴好手套、护目镜，穿实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on gloves, goggles and a lab coat beside a small spill on the bench.
shots.narration: 先保护自己：穿戴好防护用品。

shots.section_title: 第六部分：人员与环境防护
shots.scene: 无关人员图标被引导离开
shots.prompt_en: Icons of bystanders being directed away from a spill area by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 让无关的人离开。

shots.section_title: 第六部分：人员与环境防护
shots.scene: 泄漏液流向下水道口，被挡板拦住
shots.prompt_en: Spilled liquid flows toward a floor drain and is stopped by a barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 再保护环境：不让它流进下水道。

shots.scene: 泄漏区四周被吸附材料围起来
shots.prompt_en: A spill on the bench is surrounded by a ring of absorbent material. No people.
shots.narration: 清理方法：先围堵，防止扩散。

shots.scene: 小研用惰性吸附材料覆盖泄漏物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in gloves and goggles, covers the spill with dry inert absorbent material.
shots.narration: 用干沙、泥土等惰性材料吸收，

shots.scene: 收集物装进有标识的化学废物容器
shots.prompt_en: The collected material goes into a labeled chemical waste container with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 再放进化学废物容器。

shots.scene: 说明书第七格放大，里面是手和柜子
shots.prompt_en: The seventh box of the document enlarges, showing a hand and a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 第七部分：操作处置与储存。

shots.scene: 张嘴吸气的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of inhaling fumes, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时避免吸入粉尘和蒸气。

shots.scene: 阿杰在通风柜里称量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing gloves and goggles, weighs pellets inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 在通风良好的地方使用。

shots.scene: 试剂柜分格，各格标着不同象形图
shots.prompt_en: A chemical cabinet with separate compartments, each marked by a different pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 储存条件：放在哪里、怎么放。

shots.scene: 酸瓶和碱瓶被隔板隔开
shots.prompt_en: An acid bottle and a base bottle separated by a divider. No people.
shots.narration: 禁配物要分开放，比如酸和碱。

shots.scene: 氢氧化钠瓶放在干燥阴凉的柜格，瓶盖拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The pellet bottle sits in a cool, dry cabinet compartment with its cap tightly closed. No people.
shots.narration: 氢氧化钠：阴凉干燥，远离酸和金属。

shots.scene: 瓶盖拧紧的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand screwing a bottle cap tightly closed.
shots.narration: 用完立刻盖紧，防止吸潮。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着说明书后面变灰的九格
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the nine grey boxes at the back of the booklet.
shots.narration: 第八到十六部分，下集再讲。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上七个格子依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where seven boxes light up one by one.
shots.narration: SDS 是法定的化学品说明书。

shots.scene: 后三个格子亮起：消防、泄漏、操作储存
shots.prompt_en: Three more boxes light up: fire, spill, handling and storage icons.
shots.narration: 前七部分：从名称到储存。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴好手套护目镜，对照文件在通风柜里称量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in gloves and goggles, weighs pellets in a fume hood while a blank document lies beside him.
shots.narration: 用之前，先读 SDS。

shots.scene: 小研给阿杰竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gives the young male student a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 操作、储存、急救，都能查到。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着说明书向镜头挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hugs the booklet and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 下集接着读后九部分，再见！
